⚡️ Qatar says Iran, US send positive signals on diplomatic resolution

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Qatar’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs says it has received positive signals from Iran and the United States regarding a diplomatic resolution to their differences, stressing that Doha will continue its mediation efforts to reach a comprehensive agreement and ensure regional security and stability.

The ministry said Doha’s mediation efforts to resolve the crisis between Iran and the United States are ongoing, adding that it has received positive signals and positions from both sides regarding a diplomatic settlement of their differences, according to the Doha-based Al Jazeera television on Tuesday.
​
It stressed that Qatar is pursuing every opportunity to achieve a peaceful solution and supports negotiations aimed at reaching a comprehensive agreement and ensuring regional security and stability.
​
The ministry also said that a Qatari delegation’s visit to Tehran was part of diplomatic consultations and regional talks, which were subsequently followed by discussions involving Qatari officials in Washington to reach a political solution to the crisis between Iran and the United States.
